tldr: Headlines across all eight country buckets frame the MV Ocean Winner sinking as an acute safety crisis — 22 crew missing, two rescued — with every outlet maintaining a factual rescue register; South China Morning Post and Dainik Bhaskar are the only mastheads to foreground the Chinese nationality of those on board, introducing a quiet external-relations dimension absent from other headlines.

single_outlet_findings.finding: Only outlet to foreground Chinese nationality in the headline ('India rescues 2 Chinese nationals'), framing India's response as a bilateral India-China event rather than a generic maritime rescue; no other English masthead names the victims' nationality.

bottom_line: The headline layer presents a uniform safety-crisis register — sinking, missing crew, rescue launches — with SCMP the sole outlier to inject a national-identity dimension by specifying 'Chinese nationals' in the lede.
